description: Transfer files from a cloud integration (AWS S3, Azure, Dropbox, etc.) or MASV Storage Gateway to MASV. Creates a new package and initiates the transfer. Use list_files_on_integration first to get file information including IDs.

files.description: Array of files/directories to transfer from the integration

id.description: File ID, for Storage Gateway it is full file path (path + filename)

kind.description: Type of item: file or directory

integrationId.description: ID of the cloud or storage gateway integration

notifyEmail.description: Email to notify on transfer completion

recipients.description: Email addresses to send package to

name: transfer_files_from_integration
